cohort: The study participants were women who gave birth in Atbara Maternity Hospital, consisting of 187 in the case group (cesarean delivery) and 187 in the control group (vaginal delivery).
finding: History of previous cesarean delivery (AOR = 43.25) and rural residence (AOR = 1.74) were significant determinants of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: History of previous cesarean delivery and rural residence were the primary factors determining cesarean deliveries.
birth_weight: Newborn birth weight was measured but not found to be associated with cesarean delivery.
